profile_text.body:
Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Company Limited describes itself as the world's dedicated semiconductor foundry since 1987. Per its own site, it supports an ecosystem of global customers and partners with process technology and a portfolio of design enablement solutions, and it presents its business model as a driver of innovation in integrated circuit design and product applications. The company also states that it contributes to global IC innovation and to Taiwan's economy.

The company is a public company headquartered in Hsinchu, traded under the ticker TSM, and registered with the SEC under CIK 0001046179. Its site material does not describe specific AI products, and no lawsuits or MCP servers involving the company are recorded.
